parameters.name: DestinationCidrBlock
parameters.description: The destination CIDR block of the route entry. IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR blocks are supported.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: **1** to **500**. Default value: **50**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token for the next query. Valid values:
- If **NextToken** is empty, no next query exists.
- If **NextToken** has a value, the value indicates the token for the next query.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: TargetInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the route publish target.

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description: The type of the route publish target.
